meta.title: Industries — Is Forcelis for your business?
meta.description: Forcelis works with manufacturing, distribution, B2B commerce, import and export, professional services and growing businesses — companies with 10 to 100 employees, established revenue, and inventory or credit terms.

hero.title: Different industries. Connected business problems.
hero.subtitle: The method is the same everywhere. What changes is which numbers explain the business — and that is set per sector, in configuration, not rewritten per client.

fit.title: Is Forcelis for your business?
fit.intro: It is built for companies with enough operating complexity that the answer is not visible from the income statement alone.
fit.note: These companies rarely have a full internal bench — CFO, controller, financial analyst, data analyst, supply chain analyst. Forcelis works as an extension of the team they do have.

sectorsTitle: Where the analysis is strongest today

sectors.title: Manufacturing
sectors.lead: Where margin is made or lost between the purchase order and the finished unit.

sectors.title: Distribution
sectors.lead: High volume, thin margin, and a working capital cycle that punishes small errors.

sectors.title: B2B Commerce
sectors.lead: A handful of accounts usually explain most of the revenue — and most of the risk.

sectors.title: Import & Export
sectors.lead: Currency, landed cost and lead time turn a simple margin question into a timing question.
points: Currency exposure in the cost base

sectors.title: Professional Services
sectors.lead: No inventory to hide behind. Profitability is a question of mix, utilization and collection.

sectors.title: Growing Businesses
sectors.lead: Growth hides problems. It also creates them faster than the reporting can describe them.
points: Whether growth is funded by margin or by receivables

config.title: Sector logic lives in configuration
config.body: Sector metrics, trade abbreviations, input categories and thresholds are declared in configuration files, not written into the product per client. Adding a sector is a configuration change, which is why the analysis of a new industry does not restart from zero.

closing.title: Your industry is not on the list?
closing.body: The list reflects where the analysis is strongest today, not where it is possible. Tell us about the business and we will say plainly whether we can help.
